    seen = set()
    objects = []

    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):

            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    p = (y + dy, x + dx)
                    if (0 <= p[0] < h and 0 <= p[1] < w
                            and p not in seen and grid[p[0]][p[1]] == color):
                        seen.add(p)
                        stack.append(p)

            r0, r1 = min(y for y, x in cells), max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0, c1 = min(x for y, x in cells), max(x for y, x in cells)
            shape = {(y-r0, x-c0) for y, x in cells}
            oh, ow = r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1

            empty = {(y, x) for y in range(oh) for x in range(ow)} - shape
            outside = set()
            todo = [p for p in empty if p[0] in (0, oh-1) or p[1] in (0, ow-1)]
            while todo:
                p = todo.pop()
                if p in outside or p not in empty:
                    continue
                outside.add(p)
                y, x = p
                todo.extend((y+dy, x+dx) for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)))
            hollow = bool(empty - outside)
            objects.append((r0, c0, color, shape, oh, hollow))

    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    placed = []

    # Enclosed shapes gather at the top; other shapes gather at the bottom.
    # Keep their original horizontal positions, shifting vertically only to
    # avoid overlapping objects.
    for top in (True, False):
        group = [o for o in objects if o[5] == top]
        group.sort(key=lambda o: (o[0], o[1]), reverse=not top)
        for r0, c0, color, shape, oh, hollow in group:
            rows = range(0, h-oh+1) if top else range(h-oh, -1, -1)
            for nr in rows:
                cells = {(nr+y, c0+x) for y, x in shape}
                if all(0 <= x < w and not any((y, x) in old for old in placed)
                       for y, x in cells):
                    for y, x in cells:
                        out[y][x] = color
                    placed.append(cells)
                    break
    return out
